guide.summary: Composio has no managed OAuth app for Xero, so you must register your own Xero developer app and give its client ID and secret to Composio. Prototyping against your own or demo Xero organisations looks straightforward. Distributing to many customers adds Xero App Store certification (10 beta customers first) and an annual security assessment once you pass 1,000 connections.

composio.note: Composio lists Xero under 'Bring your own OAuth app'. Use the Composio credential guide and copy the redirect URI from your Composio dashboard when creating the auth config.

need_own_app.answer: Yes. Composio does not provide a managed OAuth app for Xero, so you must bring your own client ID and secret.
reasons: Composio-managed OAuth is not available for the Xero toolkit.
Any production use requires your own app, and wide distribution requires App Store certification and security assessment.

scenarios.label: Prototype or single-organisation use
scenarios.when_this_applies: You connect your own Xero organisation(s) or demo companies to test an agent. No public listing.

hands_on.basis: Estimate from step count, not measured; Xero's app registration pages were not readable (JS-rendered). See c1, c2.

waiting.basis: No review step was found for self-registered apps in the sources read; the connection cap for uncertified apps is unverified (c8).

scenarios.approval: None found for basic use. Development-mode connection limits are unverified.

scenarios.label: Public app for many customers (App Store)
scenarios.when_this_applies: You want many unrelated Xero customers to connect and want to be listed in the Xero App Store.

hands_on.basis: Depends on onboarding 10 beta customers and meeting certification checkpoints, which were not read (c5, c6).

waiting.basis: No official end-to-end App Store review timeline was found. Only the security assessment timing is documented (c4).

scenarios.approval: App Store certification, with 10 beta customers required before applying, plus the security assessment.

scenarios.label: Scaling past 1,000 connections
scenarios.when_this_applies: Your app consumes the Accounting, Payroll or similar Xero APIs and exceeds 1,000 connections, or uses Practice Manager, HQ or Tax APIs.

hands_on.estimate: About 5 working days for the assessment
hands_on.basis: c4 (Xero's stated typical time to complete the assessment).

waiting.estimate: About 5-10 working days for Xero's review, plus possible remediation (30 days to submit a plan, 60 to implement)

scenarios.approval: Annual security self-assessment reviewed by Xero's security team.

prerequisites.title: Xero login and developer account
prerequisites.detail: You need a Xero account to access the developer centre and register an app. The registration pages could not be read, so exact fields are unverified.

prerequisites.title: A Xero organisation to test against
prerequisites.detail: A demo company or your own organisation. Demo companies do not count as beta customers for App Store applications.

prerequisites.title: Composio account and dashboard access
prerequisites.detail: You need the redirect/callback URI shown for the Xero auth config in your Composio dashboard.

prerequisites.title: For App Store: 10 beta customers
prerequisites.detail: Real, non-demo Xero organisations with API calls made in the last 30 days.

steps.title: Decide your scenario and draft scopes
steps.detail: An agent can list the Xero API scopes your agent's tools need, using Composio's Xero toolkit tool list, and draft a minimal scope set with justifications. Verify the scope names against Xero's current docs, which could not be read here.
inputs: List of Xero actions your agent must perform
steps.done_when: You have a minimal scope list with a one-line reason per scope.

steps.title: Register an app in the Xero developer portal
steps.detail: Log in to the Xero developer portal and create an OAuth 2.0 app. Follow the Composio guide for the specifics. Leave the redirect URI to be filled in from Composio in the next step.
steps.done_when: You have a client ID and can generate a client secret.

steps.title: Get the redirect URI from Composio
steps.detail: In the Composio dashboard, start creating an auth config for the Xero toolkit with custom credentials and copy the redirect/callback URI it shows. Do not hard-code a URL from elsewhere.
steps.done_when: You have the Composio redirect URI copied.

steps.title: Add the redirect URI to your Xero app
steps.detail: Paste the Composio redirect URI into the Xero app's redirect URI setting and save. An agent can compare the two strings for exact match.
steps.done_when: Xero app lists the exact Composio redirect URI.

steps.title: Create the Composio auth config
steps.detail: Enter the Xero client ID and client secret in the Composio auth config, select the scopes from step 1, and save.
steps.done_when: The auth config exists in Composio.

steps.title: Connect a Xero organisation and test
steps.detail: Authorise a Xero organisation through a Composio connection and run a read-only tool call. The authorize endpoint is live and rejects unknown client IDs with an error page, so an error right away usually means a wrong client ID.
steps.done_when: A Composio connection is active and a Xero tool call returns data.

steps.title: Onboard 10 beta customers
steps.detail: Get 10 real (non-demo) Xero organisations actively using your integration, with API calls in the last 30 days, before the application form unlocks.
steps.done_when: The developer centre shows the application form as available.

steps.title: Prepare certification and security material
steps.detail: An agent can draft a checklist from Xero's certification checkpoints page and the security standard, and draft answers for the self-assessment. You must review them for accuracy. The checkpoints page was not read here.
steps.done_when: A reviewed draft checklist and assessment answers exist.

steps.title: Submit the application and assessment
steps.detail: Submit the App Store application and, where required, the security self-assessment through Xero.

steps.title: Wait for Xero review and fix remediation items
steps.detail: Xero emails the result. If you do not pass, you get a remediation report: 30 days to submit a plan and 60 days to implement. Annual re-assessment follows.

traps.title: Demo companies do not count as beta customers
traps.detail: Beta customers must not be demo companies and must have had API calls in the last 30 days.

traps.title: Application form is locked until you have 10 beta customers
traps.detail: You cannot submit for the App Store before reaching the threshold; the form is greyed out.

traps.title: Security assessment is annual
traps.detail: Passing once is not enough; it must be repeated every year.

traps.title: Do not rely on managed Composio auth
traps.detail: Composio lists Xero as bring-your-own, so a connection without your own credentials will not work.

blockers.symptom: Xero login error page right after redirecting to the authorize URL
blockers.what_it_means: Xero rejects unknown or invalid client IDs with an error page.
blockers.what_to_do: Re-copy the client ID from your Xero app into the Composio auth config and check the redirect URI matches exactly.
blockers.agent_can_help: Compare the client ID and redirect URI strings you paste against what is configured.

blockers.symptom: App Store application form is greyed out
blockers.what_it_means: You have fewer than 10 qualifying beta customers.
blockers.what_to_do: Onboard more real (non-demo) organisations with recent API activity.
blockers.agent_can_help: Draft outreach messages to accountants or bookkeepers for beta testers.

blockers.what_it_means: Some items did not meet the standard.
blockers.what_to_do: Submit a remediation plan within 30 days and implement within 60 days.
blockers.agent_can_help: Draft the remediation plan from the report for your review.

open_questions: What is the connection cap for an uncertified (development) Xero app? Check developer.xero.com/pricing and /faq/getting-started.
Which scopes are available, and are granular scopes required for new apps? Read the Xero OAuth2 scopes page in a browser.
What are Xero's API rate limits?
What is the end-to-end App Store review time and any listing fees? Check the commercial terms and the certification checkpoints page.
Is the security assessment needed before 1,000 connections for App Store listing? The FAQ says all app partners need one to be certified or listed.
